factors.call: green and body >= 0.3 * range and ((wk.lo_ran[1] == 1 and wk.lo_ret[1] == 0 and close > wk.lo_ext[1] and close[1] <= wk.lo_ext[1]) or (wk.lo_ret[1] == 1 and close > close[1]))

heads_up.call: wk.lo_lvl > 0 and wk.lo_run >= 1 and ((red and ((wk.lo_closes == 0 and wk.lo_dist <= 1) or wk.lo_closes >= 2)) or wk.lo_ret == 1)
heads_up.put: wk.hi_lvl > 0 and wk.hi_run >= 1 and ((green and ((wk.hi_closes == 0 and wk.hi_dist <= 1) or wk.hi_closes >= 2)) or wk.hi_ret == 1)

text.call: A hammer formed a weak low at {wk.lo_lvl} ({wk.lo_run} candles ago). Price is {wk.lo_dist} ATR over it (negative = below it) and has closed below it {wk.lo_closes} time(s) in a row. If a green candle now closes above the hammer's high {wk.lo_ext} (or, when the first green candle back has already printed, a second green candle in a row closes higher), the CALL signal follows.
text.put: A shooting star formed a weak high at {wk.hi_lvl} ({wk.hi_run} candles ago). Price is {wk.hi_dist} ATR under it (negative = above it) and has closed above it {wk.hi_closes} time(s) in a row. If a red candle now closes below the star's low {wk.hi_ext} (or, when the first red candle back has already printed, a second red candle in a row closes lower), the PUT signal follows.

heads_up.title: weak level ahead
